integrity: The proof is analytic: order-three Haar pushforward, strict convexity in coefficient balance, and a divided-difference phase monotonicity. Finite computations are corroboration, not the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only two distinct characters with relative character of exact order three are treated.
No theorem is claimed for more than two frequencies, p<=2, or other relative orders.
Historical equivalent Lp subspace calculations may exist under unfamiliar terminology.
title: A sharp phase transition for an order-three character pair
